---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity), Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  add_count(Activity) |>
  filter(n >= 50) |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  arrange(Activity, Fatal_clean)
```
